name: Duck Shooter VR
summary:
Relive the timeless joy of duck hunting in this fully immersive VR reimagining of the retro classic! Duck Hunt VR brings back everything you loved about the original—flying ducks, fast reflexes, and that iconic dog—now rebuilt from the ground up for Meta Quest.

Gameplay Features
Grab your shotgun and shoot ducks as they fly across the sky

React fast before the ducks escape

Watch your loyal hunting dog retrieve and present your trophies

Enjoy intuitive VR controls and realistic reloading

Why You'll Love
